propositions: The inbound (inbound, probe) dispatch chain has zero callers: producer differ._compute_mutations_emit_absent_partner_probes, dispatch arm _run_differs_inbound_probe_dispatch, and reconcile_helpers.route_inbound_probe were all removed by bug 3b5f, leaving SupportsAbsenceProbe and three probe_remote implementations with no consumers.
The inbound absence-probe port must not be used to restore same-pass re-creation of deleted issues, eliminating its stated original purpose and making re-homing to binding_walk unsafe.

Deletion is provably safe and behavior-neutral: semantic search and string grep both confirm no live caller exists outside the port itself and its own tests, and the outbound probe leaf remains live and untouched.

Deleting the classifier leaves the jira.resolved_statuses and reconciler.resolved_statuses config keys orphaned, which is deferred to follow-up ticket as a user-visible surface change requiring separate deprecate-vs-remove decision.
